provenance.source: new: 2026-10-24 real-host bug. Claude Code 2.1.306 never showed the ; menu (with 0, 2 and 3 shortcuts) while Pi's worked in the same home: typed keys reached the core as untyped resyncs, so the menu never saw a typed ;. Rows are read off Claude's native completion list (harness/murmo_harness/validation/integration.py claude_menu_rows), so the cases are Claude's own
provenance.author: murmo

cases.note: Typing ; at a word start opens the menu with every shortcut (phase 16).
A query that matches nothing shows no rows, not the rows of the key before.
Tab inserts the selected row's expansion in place of the typed ;query.
Down moves the selection inside Claude's list (not prompt history) and Tab inserts it.
Enter on a row Claude inserts itself closes the menu and keeps the draft; the raw ;h is never sent (fixtures/menu/enter.json, Claude profile).
Escape closes the list and leaves the typed ;h.
